_comment: Modeled on the markdown_here submission: strict_min_version 115.0 while messages.tags.list was added in Thunderbird 121, but the call sits below a guard clause that returns when the API is absent. strict-min-version-api never rejects - whether a construction keeps the call off the versions that lack the API is a judgement - so the site is raised for a reader under Extended Code Review (see the golden .txt). What this pins is that a GUARDED call is still shown: the reader needs the site in order to point at the guard and settle it.
